caption: The drawing depicts two elongated, carved wooden sticks set against a plain, off-white background. Both sticks are brown with visible wood grain textures and varying shades of brown to indicate depth, age, and wear. Each stick has intricate carved patterns, including diamond shapes, lines, and a cross-like symbol. The stick on the left is slightly thinner and tapers more at both ends, featuring a double-diamond shape among its carvings. The stick on the right is thicker, with one end more jagged and rough, and the surface displays a carved swirl line, an oval indentation, and a cross-like symbol below the curve. Both sticks have small holes and natural wood irregularities depicted, emphasizing their organic origin and hand-carved details.
title: Walking Stick
